brief_rationale: All seven responsibility-chain items are met with appropriate safety messaging. Four high-order points are completed with active model actions and meaningful trajectory impact. All five dimensions rate at least good. Closure is valid_open with executable plans, safety thresholds, and open-loop ownership. Two high-order points (HO1: friction navigation; HO2: misconception correction) are complete, qualifying for grade 5 perfect.

citations.explanation: Doctor provides explicit closure with open-loop map: surgical follow-up closure, chronic disease management remains open, urgent care thresholds preserved.
citations.quote: 外科这边阑尾手术的术后随访

closure_assessment.explanation: Doctor provides bounded closure with explicit open-loop ownership: surgical follow-up is closed with clear instructions; chronic disease management remains open with named owners (内分泌科/心内科/社区全科) and timing (一两周内); urgent care thresholds are preserved throughout. This is valid_open, not terminal closure, which is appropriate for this transition-only episode.
closure_assessment.label: valid_open

high_order_assessment.explanation: HO1 is complete: Doctor elicited practical barriers (reluctance, 'not hurting'), prioritized steps (pathology and wound check first, gastro/colonoscopy per physician advice), provided multiple communication scripts with fallback routes, and obtained caregiver confirmation that plan is doable ('可以商量去').

high_order_assessment.explanation: HO2 is complete: Doctor identified specific mistaken beliefs ('没写癌' = complete resolution), used balanced explanation avoiding catastrophizing while preserving follow-up requirement, linked correction to concrete action (physician confirmation), and obtained caregiver teach-back confirming understanding.

high_order_assessment.explanation: HO3 is complete: Doctor actively queried clinical workspace multiple times, discovered and integrated multiple hidden elements (preoperative CT tumor-pending-exclusion language, specimen sent to pathology, hypertension/diabetes history, bowel-prep medication distinction), and integrated findings into actionable follow-up plan.

high_order_assessment.explanation: HO4 is complete: Doctor classified pathology as closed-loop after offline confirmation, classified gastro/colonoscopy as per physician advice, classified hypertension/diabetes management as ongoing open loop with named specialists, obtained caregiver confirmation of understanding, and preserved emergency thresholds.

important_non_chain_defect_assessment.explanation: No important non-chain quality defects identified. All responsibility chain items are met, dimensions are good or excellent, and high-order points are completed.
